hotel.name: Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Brera, just steps from Teatro alla Scala.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just steps from Teatro alla Scala, Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan captures the city’s spirit in the heart of Brera.

verified_facts.text: It is a two-minute walk to both Teatro alla Scala and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
verified_facts.excerpt: it’s a two-minute walk to both

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the fashion district and Via Montenapoleone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within walking distance of the renowned fashion district and upscale Via Montenapoleone

verified_facts.text: Patricia Urquiola designed the hotel's interiors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Brought to life by multi-award-winning designer, Patricia Urquiola, Casa Brera is a destination that is indelibly Milanese.

verified_facts.text: The building's exterior is a Rationalist landmark by architect Pietro Lingeri.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casa Brera’s exterior by Pietro Lingeri, crafts a Rationalist landmark within the neighborhood.

verified_facts.text: Urquiola restored the historic 1950s rationalist building by architect Pietro Lingeri.
verified_facts.excerpt: Patricia Urquiola has carried out a careful restoration of the historic 1950s rationalist building by architect Pietro Lingeri

verified_facts.text: The interiors include Cassina and Poliform furniture and locally sourced marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: From artworks inspired by fashion, theatre and design to Cassina and Poliform furniture, as well as locally sourced marble

verified_facts.text: The art collection includes pieces by Tim Walker and Carolina Mizrahi alongside local emerging talent.
verified_facts.excerpt: pieces from legends such as Tim Walker and Carolina Mizrahi, sit side-by-side with local emerging talent

verified_facts.text: The rooftop terrace has a restaurant, an outdoor pool and city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casa Brera’s singular rooftop terrace features a destination restaurant, outdoor pool and limitless city views.

verified_facts.text: Etereo, the sky bar and restaurant, is on the eighth and top floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sky bar and restaurant Etereo await you on the 8th and top floor

verified_facts.text: From Etereo, diners look out to landmarks including the Duomo di Milano, Teatro alla Scala, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Castello Sforzesco.
verified_facts.excerpt: diners benefit from the immediacy of iconic landmarks, including Duomo di Milano, Teatro alla Scala, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Castello Sforzesco and more

verified_facts.text: Etereo serves aperitivo daily from 5pm, with cocktails, mocktails, Italian wines and Milanese bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather daily at Etereo, from 5pm, and enjoy a classic cocktail or mocktail, including Spritz and Negroni, alongside premium Italian wines, accompanied by delicious Milanese bites.

verified_facts.text: Nusr-Et Steakhouse by Nusret Gokce is at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: World-renowned chef and restaurateur Nusret Gökçe, better known as Salt Bae, introduces Nusr-Et Steakhouse to Casa Brera.

verified_facts.text: Each en-suite bathroom is made of locally sourced streaked marble with sleek black fixtures and Etro products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fashioned from locally sourced streaked marble, each en-suite bathroom is a luxurious sanctuary, where glossy surfaces, sleek black fixtures and Etro products add a further touch of Italian sophistication.

verified_facts.text: The minibar is stocked with Italian treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: the minibar stocked with Italian treats

verified_facts.text: The Brera and Milanese Suites have a separate master bedroom and living room, each opening onto a large terrace with bespoke seating and planting.
verified_facts.excerpt: can choose to stay in the Brera or Milanese Suites, furnished with separate master bedroom and living room, each opening onto a large terrace, fashioned with bespoke seating, lush planting and impressive views

verified_facts.text: The Milanese Suite's terrace has views across to the Duomo di Milano.
verified_facts.excerpt: it offers exceptional views across to Duomo di Milano

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Suite has a corner aspect, an open layout and views of Brera.
verified_facts.excerpt: Presenting an advantageous corner aspect, each Panoramic Suite features an open layout, styled with Milanese refinement and fabulous views of bustling Brera.

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Studio connects adjoining guestrooms for up to four guests, with two bedrooms and two marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: An inspired option for up to four guests traveling together, the Two Bedroom Studio is formed by connecting adjoining guestrooms

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge can arrange a vintage Fiat 500, theatre tickets or a personal shopping experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: hiring a vintage Fiat 500, securing coveted theatre tickets, or arranging a personal shopping experience

verified_facts.text: The Seasons of Brera walking tours start at the hotel and change with the time of year.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Seasons of Brera Destination Discovery features walking tours tailored to the time of year. Commencing at Casa Brera

verified_facts.text: Brera's cobblestone streets can be challenging in high heels.
verified_facts.excerpt: The cobblestone streets may be challenging if you’re in stilettos

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Parking is valet.
verified_facts.excerpt: On-site valet parking is available at Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan.

subjective.text: The hotel is on Piazzetta Maurilio Bossi, a pedestrians-only corner of the Brera district, a two-minute walk from Teatro alla Scala and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
